stories.title: Holywell strikes Gold at Wales in Bloom for the first time
stories.summary: Holywell has been awarded Gold in the town category of the Wales in Bloom Awards 2026, which Holywell Town Council says is the first time the town has achieved it. stories.title: Flintshire residents warned over council tax credit scam email
stories.summary: Flintshire residents are being warned about a scam email claiming money has been credited to their council tax account. The county council’s Trading Standards team said the email tells people a credit has been recorded against their council tax file. stories.title: New power line should run through Wales, not around it, says renewables industry report
stories.summary: A new high-voltage power line between the West Midlands and south-west England should run through mid Wales rather than around it, according to a report commissioned by the renewables industry. stories.title: Helen MacArthur appointed chief fire officer of North Wales Fire and Rescue Service
stories.summary: North Wales Fire and Rescue Service’s next chief fire officer will be a finance and governance specialist who joined the service eight years ago.
